verdict.rationale: Sardine's own getting-started docs say new users request access to a sandbox dashboard account, so the product does offer a first-party sandbox environment. Beyond that single mention, nothing describes how the sandbox is isolated from production or what testing it supports. missing for 10: documentation of sandbox vs. production data isolation, sandbox API keys/endpoints for programmatic testing, test data or simulated scenarios, any parity details between sandbox and production, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: To get started with Sardine, request access to your sandbox dashboard account.
